_comment: Research home structure. featured: works with their own pages (slug must exist in data/benchmarks/). directions: the six research directions; each gets research/<id>.html and its works are listed WITHOUT links by design.

directions.name: Benchmark
directions.blurb: Defining what counts as competence — occupation-anchored, verifier-checked measurement across knowledge, code, agents, and multimodal work.

directions.name: Reinforcement Learning
directions.blurb: Training signal beyond imitation: policy optimization and exploration methods that turn verifiable feedback into reasoning ability.

directions.name: Agents — the Auto Series
directions.blurb: Systems that carry a whole job, not a single step: autonomous pipelines that plan, execute, verify, and deliver finished work.

directions.name: Synthetic Data
directions.blurb: Manufacturing the training signal itself: instruction corpora mined, synthesized, and reconstructed at web scale.
works: Understanding by Reconstruction: Reversing the Software Development Process for LLM Pretraining

directions.name: Pretraining Compute Allocation
directions.blurb: Spending compute where thinking happens: looped architectures, dynamic depth, and routing that allocate capacity per token instead of per model.
works: Loop µP: On the Residual Scaling of Looped Transformers

directions.name: Foundation Models
directions.blurb: Fully open model families — text, code, math, and music — released with their data pipelines, recipes, and checkpoints.
